findings.source_repair: Replace algorithmic section references with admitted explicit act/reference structure where feasible.

findings.normative_basis: A13 admits explicit named-act performance; bare domain verbs such as טחון are not implicit calls.

findings.normative_basis: A13 admits only individually audited counted forms plus narrow unbounded recurrence; no generic runtime-count repetition.
findings.source_repair: Factor repeated composite work into named acts/recurrence where practical.

findings.normative_basis: A-NUM-001 freezes direct literals to canonical 1..9999 forms; semantic naturals remain unbounded.

findings.normative_basis: A-SEQ-001/A-CORE-008: adjacency, newline and bare waw do not create executable order.

findings.normative_basis: A13 provides explicit named-act performance and forbids nearest/implicit action antecedent heuristics.

findings.normative_basis: A-CORE-005..008 require preparation followed by exactly one top-level ועתה and no later definitions.

findings.normative_basis: Core has numeric data/results only; strings and runtime text are OPEN_AFTER_M2.

findings.normative_basis: A13/B12 Core numeric values are naturals; original lines 1349ff define year zero and years before zero with a minus sign.

findings.normative_basis: Frozen Core has no first-class collections; the Megillah algorithm uses runtime ordered books/lists/permutations as data.
findings.source_repair: A whole-algorithm numeral encoding would be disproportionate; request a post-M2 ordered finite collection capability.

findings.normative_basis: Frozen Core lacks general numeric ordering propositions used by רב/ימעט clauses; post-action recurrence is separate and already frozen.
findings.source_repair: Use admitted equality/recursion where local; numeric ordering itself remains a post-M2 request.

findings.normative_basis: A-OUT-002 permits at most one numeric result per act; the final source says הוצא ... חמשה דברים and two are nonnumeric names.
findings.source_repair: Potential Core repair is explicit final state-bearing result referents; no multi-result language request is asserted yet.

findings.normative_basis: A13 complete programs are closed preparation+principal executions; Core v0.1 has no source-level external program-input binding for the two days the Megillah says to take.
findings.source_repair: A fixed-query candidate can initialize input places explicitly, but a reusable Megillah needs a defined host/program input boundary.
findings.note: This is not stdin by assumption; the need is external association of two input values with explicit source roles.
